name: almosafar-taxi
description: Almosafar Taxi — passenger, driver, and admin demo monorepo

scripts.build: npm run build -w @almosafar/shared && npm run build -w @almosafar/ui
scripts.firebase:seed: npm run build:shared && npm run build --prefix firebase/functions && npm run seed --prefix firebase/functions
scripts.firebase:deploy: npm run build --prefix firebase/functions && cd firebase && firebase deploy --only firestore:rules,firestore:indexes,functions
